hooks.command: test -d node_modules || echo 'WARNING: 依赖未安装，请先运行 pnpm install'
[ "$(git branch --show-current)" != "main" ] && [ "$(git branch --show-current)" != "master" ] || { echo '{"block": true, "message": "禁止直接修改主分支，请先 git checkout -b feat/xxx"}' >&2; exit 2; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | xargs -I{} sh -c 'test -x node_modules/.bin/prettier && case "{}" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.vue|*.js|*.jsx) node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "{}" 2>/dev/null ;; esac || true'
